other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam.
Applicant must be engaged in any building and other construction work.
Applicant must be registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Applicant must have continuous membership of the Board to be eligible.
Benefits can be availed only once in a year for the annual health check‑up.
benefits_summary: Registered construction workers receive ₹5,000 once a year for an annual health check‑up at any hospital.
